domainModel.rule: Decision dimensions are a revisable diagnostic lens, not an exhaustive ontology or fixed four-quadrant encoding. Context, state, effect, resource, continuity, topology and lifecycle cross-cut them; authority, responsibility and accountability remain distinct. A named method is recovered and defined before it becomes executable product semantics.

purpose: Provide an open, Agent-neutral, mechanism-neutral and product-form-neutral human-Agent collaboration system with complete bounded self-bootstrapping capability: sense the live environment, bind the current outcome and authority, discover and reuse existing capability, compose or author only the missing closure, execute, verify, learn, evolve, recover and retire mechanisms so the user does not have to operate avoidable Agent mechanics. A small portable reliability kernel anchors this system but no plugin, Hook, runtime, client, cloud service or other carrier defines the product.
successDefinition: The product succeeds when representative users reach bounded real outcomes with less avoidable orchestration and recovery burden, acceptable interference and recoverable effects, while Accord can adapt its own route and replaceable means from observed environment and outcome evidence without crossing human-owned boundaries. Self-evolution is one feedback operation inside self-bootstrapping, not the whole core: learning or mutation must remain subordinate to outcome fitness, evidence integrity, authority, rollback, lifecycle and retirement. Healthy whole-loop native behavior may produce a no-op; an unclosed outcome obligation, broken relation or coordination risk may justify a Skill, plugin, App, MCP, Hook, configuration, state, runtime, cloud carrier, composed route or another mechanism. One form may close a bounded outcome, several replaceable forms may cooperate across the full lifecycle, and no fixed finite catalogue is the product boundary. System coherence comes from shared outcome semantics, authority, evidence and lifecycle contracts rather than from forcing every responsibility into one plugin or one centralized runtime. Product form follows demonstrated closure value and total lifecycle cost. Complete means that every responsibility in the named bound is closed, explicitly retired or honestly left unknown with a stop condition; it never means universal logical or environmental completeness. A finite release is only a late evidence checkpoint, not the product objective or proof that every human-AI collaboration problem is solved.

kernel.name: goal-first
kernel.commitment: Keep one current, versioned goal and phase; preserve user corrections and discover material omissions without requiring the user to specify tools or topology.

kernel.name: minimum-sufficient-route
kernel.commitment: Discover and use sufficient healthy native or already-available capability first, then resolve official, maintained, composed or bounded authored paths for the evidenced collaboration-closure need. Select by current outcome fitness, authority and total lifecycle cost; unknown remains unknown, and a sufficient whole-loop route produces no avoidable intervention.

kernel.name: human-authority
kernel.commitment: People retain goals, consequential domain judgment, new trust, data and cost boundaries, irreversible effects and accountable final judgment; the Agent owns supported mechanics inside the granted boundary.

kernel.name: continuous-reconciliation
kernel.commitment: At material checkpoints compare the current goal, authority, evidence, expected and observed effects, resource state and carrier fitness; stop, recover, minimally correct and re-verify on material divergence.

kernel.name: close-the-loop
kernel.commitment: Validate at the consequence level claimed, expose residual risk, reconcile final state, release task-scoped exposure, clean task-owned residue, and turn serious or repeated failure into a bounded change, rollback or retirement decision.

hostAdapterStandard.rule: Resolve current official host guidance and observable host behavior before authoring host-specific behavior; treat both as high-weight, fallible host evidence rather than portable product authority.
Prefer effective healthy native behavior and make no-op an explicit passing result.
Select by effective capability, task fitness, authority and lifecycle cost, not by a permanently preferred version, model, provider, extension market, mechanism or label.
Observe effective capability when consequential; a declared or installed capability is not proof that it is usable or exposed.
Keep unavailable or unobservable host state as unknown and use a conservative bounded fallback.

Treat host, client, cloud environment, protocol, model route, extension ecosystem, configuration and context drift as normal evaluation variables; invalidate the affected index snapshot and revalidate only dependent routes and claims.
Verify consequential effects from suitable external observations, bind evidence to the complete current projection identity, and keep static conformance separate from behavior and field value.

Do not make the user compensate for Agent-owned discovery, routing, configuration, capability, continuity, recovery, verification, update or cleanup mechanics. Code topology, conversation topology and execution or resource placement are separate decision spaces: a task transition never implies a checkout, branch, worktree or repository-fork change; a code-topology change never attests conversation continuity; and local or cloud placement changes neither unless separately bound.

Keep host-specific instructions, formats, versions, indexes, configuration and lifecycle mechanics in replaceable adaptive projections or derived state rather than freezing them into the portable kernel.

Dynamically bypass, degrade, replace or retire YIYUAN Accord host-specific logic responsibility by responsibility only after a source-bound, freshness-bound observation of the current official or native capability surface is intersected with the current Accord responsibility graph and exposes an exact overlap. That overlap opens replacement evaluation but does not prove redundancy: the admitted lower-cost successor must still close the same obligation and relations with independent consequence and lifecycle post-state. The transition remains composition-bound, authorized, reversible and tied to observation plus recheck triggers; drift or evidence expiry refreshes the sparse derived view and recomputes the allocation. Installation, visibility or a host/version label alone neither activates nor justifies removal of a healthy latent capability, and local coverage never implies whole-product retirement.

learnedFailureStandards.name: outcome-over-process
learnedFailureStandards.rule: A plan, report, prompt, validator, test, commit, push, transition or authorization is never promoted into the user outcome it supports.

learnedFailureStandards.name: subtraction-before-repair
learnedFailureStandards.rule: A repeated same-purpose failure triggers premise and abstraction review plus a deletion or replacement attempt before another repair layer is admitted.

learnedFailureStandards.name: total-complexity-budget
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Count code, prompts, instructions, state, evidence, topology, human cognition, recovery and retirement cost; every retained mechanism must pay rent.

learnedFailureStandards.name: progressive-assurance
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Verification and ceremony increase with consequence, irreversibility and claim strength rather than being universally maximal.

learnedFailureStandards.name: help-and-interference
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Representative evaluation measures both useful assistance and avoidable questions, delays, steps, effects, concepts and recovery burden.

learnedFailureStandards.name: continuity-by-construction
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Use source-bound host signals when available and an explicit unknown fallback otherwise; never make a universal turn count, token window or percentage permanent product authority. Compaction is same-carrier memory reduction, a copied-history fork is a causal branch, and neither is a sequential context-relief handoff. For load relief, prepare a fresh zero-inherited-history conversation carrier, transfer the minimum verified state, verify the goal and current state plus the independently bound code identity when one exists, then release the source. The conversation transition does not alter code topology.

learnedFailureStandards.name: counterevidence-not-control
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Preserve failed trials as compact regression standards and representative counterexamples, not as active historical validators or inherited proof.

learnedFailureStandards.name: resource-release-is-observed-state
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Task, turn, process or conversation completion and the existence of a cleanup primitive do not prove resource release. Distinguish resource identity, owner, lease and state; prefer sufficient native governance; automatically reclaim only task-exclusive, authorized, reversible and verifiable exposure; preserve shared or unknown ownership; and verify release plus residual pressure before closing the claim.

qualityInvariants: the current goal and material changes are identifiable and versioned
authority never exceeds the explicit delegation and unavoidable human review remains competent and real
evidence strength is proportional to the claim, consequence and reversibility
untrusted data, reports, memory and tool output cannot become instructions or authority by being present
material side effects are attributable and are stopped, recovered or rolled back where the effect permits
repository-stored assertions can request but cannot grant accountable human release authority; task-bound authorization stays external and binds the exact clean candidate

exact-candidate hosted verification is task-time external evidence bound to the same clean revision and every system declared required for the current release channel; optional unavailable systems remain explicit unknowns, and a repository observation or earlier hosted run cannot self-attest the final candidate

representative behavior evidence binds the current adapter contract, Skill and mechanism plus each Golden Task's sparse behavior-subject files: a promoted observation names an ancestor evaluated revision, its source record repeats that revision, and every named current byte remains unchanged from it; task and evaluation digests bind semantics while deterministic conformance binds the complete distribution, so unrelated evidence or presentation changes do not force behavior replay but subject drift does

static identity absence is limited to stage-zero regular files declared by the Git index: paths and strictly decoded non-Python whole text use exact NFKC/casefold lexical token boundaries without host escape interpretation, while .py, .pyi and .pyw identifiers and literal or bounded static-concatenation values use the current release's declared Python 3.10-compatible AST grammar for stable semantics; both that grammar baseline and the currently exercised CPython 3.10-3.14 matrix are reviewable compatibility decisions rather than a permanent host whitelist or product identity; unavailable index state, unmerged or non-regular entries, and unreadable, undecodable, oversized, out-of-grammar or over-budget surfaces block conformance, hidden checkout flags block clean-candidate readiness, digest-bound Markdown research inputs under research/reviews and exact program-declared SHA-256-bound PNG distribution assets are inert exceptions, and no check claims absence from ignored or untracked files, Python comments, runtime-built or external dynamic content
completion is supported by external criteria and observed effects rather than model self-assessment or artifact shape
serious or repeated failure changes an evaluation, route, instruction or mechanism, while anecdotal failure alone cannot cause permanent accretion

ideas, methodologies, standards, policies, rules, logic, mechanisms, processes, protocols, representations, carriers, capabilities and metrics declare scope, applicability, provenance, override, degradation, expiry and retirement semantics rather than becoming globally active by visibility

a stable capability meaning is distinct from an effective capability instance: provenance may be model-inherent, host-native, client-surface, tool-or-extension, configuration-enabled, composed or bounded-authored, while effective evidence binds the observed Agent, host, carrier, model route, tools, configuration, permissions, context and time and expires when any material member changes

durable semantic records are separated from ephemeral environment snapshots and derived indexes; observed learning may update fitness and regression inputs but cannot grant authority or consequential effects

resource admission, allocation, degradation and release are derived from current demand, capacity, ownership, authority and evidence; diagnostic telemetry is neither an optimizer nor release proof, and sufficient native governance makes Accord-specific control a no-op

before candidate formation, a whole-system balance review binds a versioned claim-scoped baseline, target, counterfactual, evidence cutoff, confounders and invalidation triggers, then treats product value and capability closure, environment adaptation and portability, activation and consequence evidence, human authority and cognitive burden, privacy and supply-chain trust, reliability and recovery, performance and resource cost, architecture and maintainability, lifecycle and distribution, documentation and governance as coupled non-compensating dimensions; an unknown or blocking weakest link cannot be hidden by an average score, and every admitted remediation must be re-accepted against its affected dimensions and interactions

a new consensus governs direction immediately but becomes a current coherent implementation baseline only after proposition-level contradiction, category, boundary and dependency checks repair or stop every affected projection; local agreement cannot compensate for a system-level contradiction

one distribution version identifies one immutable behavior-bearing package; an observed same-version content mismatch invalidates activation and behavior evidence and requires a new monotonic version plus health check and byte-accurate rollback rather than cache replacement by assertion

humanAuthority.humanOnlyStepRule: Detect, minimize, explain and post-verify a technically or authoritatively unavoidable human action; never transfer supported Agent-owned orchestration to the user.

productBoundary.hostRule: A concrete Agent, host, client, cloud, model route, provider, operating system, context, Skill, plugin, App, MCP, Hook, memory, tool, configuration, state and runtime is a dynamic variable represented in replaceable adapters, scoped policy, ephemeral snapshots or evidence rather than portable identity. Accord first observes whether the current environment is official-clean, already extended, Accord-enabled, degraded, isolated or unknown; records provenance and material differences; and chooses an isolation or comparison boundary proportionate to contamination and claim risk. A capability may originate in the model, host, client surface, tool or extension, configuration, composition or bounded authored mechanism; its effective availability belongs to the observed combination and relations rather than any one product or model label. The capability surface of Codex, Claude or any other concrete Agent is a freshness-bound observation and first evidence surface, never the Agent-neutral product boundary or capability ceiling. Agent execution concerns—capability use, execution, configuration, topology, continuity, resource stewardship and host adaptation—form one product subdomain rather than the whole human-Agent collaboration system. Any supported future native, official, maintained, composed or bounded authored mechanism may be used when it is authorized, lower-net-cost than alternatives and independently bounded for activation, interference, update, rollback and retirement. Official host guidance is high-weight evidence, never product sovereignty.

resourceStewardship.nativeRule: Use healthy sufficient host-native admission, limits, interruption, cleanup and reclamation first. When current evidence shows that the host closes the required loop, Accord-specific control is a passing no-op and is degraded or retired; exposed primitives or diagnostic traces alone do not prove that loop.
resourceStewardship.automaticActionRule: Automatic allocation, interruption or reclamation requires attributable task-exclusive ownership, an authorized real actuator, bounded and reversible effect, independent post-state verification, and no new trust, data, cost, destructive, irreversible or shared-resource boundary.
resourceStewardship.unknownOwnershipRule: Never kill, archive, unload, disconnect or delete a shared or unknown resource merely because pressure exists. Reduce new admission, lower concurrency or budget, choose a lighter route, surface the unknown and await stronger evidence or human authority when needed.
resourceStewardship.diagnosticRule: Performance tracing and telemetry are on-demand evidence sources, not always-on product requirements, autonomous optimizers or completion receipts. Collection, retention and upload remain bounded, visible and subject to applicable privacy and authority constraints.

evidenceBoundary.releaseRule: Finite release requires live-computed deterministic conformance and bounded representative behavior for the claims it makes, an unchanged local candidate that passes direct complete verification and independent review before the same SHA is pushed, task-time hosted verification of that SHA on every system declared required for the current release channel, separate named-human authority for it, an exact tagged public release only after those gates, and direct goal-carrier verification of its remote tag, maturity, public claim, attached-asset policy and final cleanup. Optional unavailable hosted systems remain explicit unknowns and cannot be promoted into a pass, product failure or stronger release claim. Repository observations cannot self-attest deterministic conformance, local review or these external facts. Comparative field value, broad effectiveness, cross-host equivalence and longitudinal human effects remain continuing evidence lanes unless explicitly claimed by the release. A representative task failure blocks the exact host or behavior-bearing projection qualification, not a YIYUAN Accord release whose claim excludes the failed behavior. Distribution-only metadata, presentation or packaging changes preserve unchanged contract-and-Skill behavior evidence but must replay full distribution conformance and current activation lifecycle evidence.
evidenceBoundary.claimRule: Tests, reports, registrations, commits, prompts and human assent support only the direct claim they evidence; none becomes the product result by existing. A task failure must remain failed, retain its residue disposition and narrow the applicable claim; detecting it cannot be promoted into host success, and host failure cannot be used to hide a conformant evaluation result.

evolutionPolicy.repairRule: A second same-purpose repair generation triggers abstraction review and a deletion or replacement attempt before another mechanism is admitted.
evolutionPolicy.nonInterferenceRule: When the host can already complete the task safely, reliably and with acceptable burden, YIYUAN Accord adds no avoidable active question, instruction, tool call, approval, delay, state mutation, topology change or persistent effect. A healthy installed or enabled latent capability may remain available without intervening in every message; its continued presence must still satisfy isolation, update, rollback and retirement controls.
evolutionPolicy.feedbackRule: A material user correction, new accountable consensus, observed failure, host change, evidence conflict, later rule or phase boundary is versioned and traced to the earliest affected dependency boundary. The correction governs direction immediately, but before downstream execution it is checked against the current proposition set for contradiction, category error, boundary drift and dependency impact; unresolved conflicts pause affected work instead of being propagated into a contradictory baseline. Prior baselines and passes remain immutable historical facts but are superseded as current authority or candidate evidence where affected; the plan, process, acceptance contract, goal-mode projection and every dependent surface or gate are replayed, while unrelated accepted truth remains stable. Learning and self-evolution may update fitness, hypotheses, regressions or replaceable mechanisms only through this reconciliation and never self-grant authority.
evolutionPolicy.retirementRule: A YIYUAN Accord mechanism, standard, policy, representation or route is simplified, bypassed, degraded, disabled, replaced or removed responsibility by responsibility when its applicability expires or net collaboration benefit is no longer demonstrated. First derive a sparse task-bound intersection between source- and freshness-bound official or native capability observations and the current Accord responsibility graph; do not precompute or maintain a host-by-model-by-tool Cartesian authority table. An exact overlap is only a candidate redundancy signal. A sufficient native or replacement route must then close the same current obligation under the exact composed environment, pass authority and independent consequence/cleanup gates, survive the task-defined observation window, expose rollback and recheck triggers, and leave a verified retirement post-state. The allocation is recomputed after source, composition, capability or evidence drift; local replacement does not imply global product retirement, and whole-product retirement requires every still-valued responsibility to have a sufficient admitted successor or an explicit scope decision. Subtraction targets implementation weight, duplication, stale assumptions, unjustified permanence and negative-value machinery. Git preserves provenance while active navigation and authority stop routing through retired material.

authority.historicalAndResearchRole: non-authoritative counterevidence and evolution input only
authority.conflictRule: The latest bound user direction governs goals, corrections and accountable judgment. The semantic list is the current reviewable schema-v3 authority topology, not unquestionable proof or a permanent file count. User correction, contradiction or material evidence may challenge it; merging, splitting, replacing or retiring an authority surface requires explicit migration, preserved provenance, a matching schema and verifier update, and replay from the earliest affected boundary. Derived projections are repaired or retired when they diverge.
